about_the_game:
Over an hour of music from the soundtrack to Dying Breed. 

About the Composers Tracks 1-9, the Empire of the Ascending Order OST anthems

Juan Ignacio Lopez

With nearly 20 years of experience in the music industry,

He has developed a multifaceted career as an electronic producer and composer in Uruguay. His work has been recognized in prominent projects such as "La Mala Lengua" and "La Imbailable".

He has shared the stage with famous Uruguayan Bands such as Trotsky Vengaran, La Tabaré and No te va Gustar, establishing his presence in the national music scene.

In recent years, he has focused on composing and producing original soundtracks (OST) for video games, collaborating with studios in Uruguay and working alongside international musicians.

His background as a pianist and keyboardist (playing since the age of 5 ) along with experience in sound design, allows him to create immersive and original soundscapes tailored to each project's needs. Juan's passion for music and technology drives him to continue exploring new forms of sonic expression, always seeking excellence and innovation in every work he undertakes.

Pablo Fraga

Is a composer and music producer from Uruguay. Twice nominated for the Graffiti Awards with the band Ángel, his work focuses on musical arrangements, original composition, and music for audiovisual media. After finishing his degree in Composition at Universidad de la República in Uruguay, he moved to Berlin, from where he has had the opportunity to collaborate on projects in countries across Europe, including Spain, Germany, and Scotland. Beyond the studio, he plays guitar and saxophone, bringing his versatile sound to each project.

About the Composers Tracks 10-19, West World Alliance OST anthems

Fernando Espinosa

Born in the country side far away from the city, developed an interest in music from a young age. Encouraged by his family he went to Argentina at age 18 yo to study music. After finishing his studies he moved back to Uruguay and started giving music lessons to young people and whilst performing in several bands at the same time. Credited professional musician on many Uruguayan and Argentinean albums.

Production and lyrics:

Ignacio Trelles

Friends with all musicians who met in the neighborhood and from local band called "La Mala Lengua". Ignacio started making music for Dying Breed since the beginning, meeting mostly on Saturday morning and Wednesday afternoon to design the perfect OST. Wrote the lyrics of the songs for the OST,  and has a backlog of lyrics yet to see the light of dayt yet! Due to fans loving Dying Breed songs we had been sharing the soundtrack online, which has lead to collaborating on music and sounds for other international games.

Collaboration:

Juan Jose Lopez

Older brother of Juan Ignacio, bassist of many local bands and DB bass composer when needed.

Mastering:

Each composer and their band was responsible for the mastering of their respective music.
